sentences.text: Shri Kshitij Vyas Pl appearing on behalf of Advocate Ge  ORDER Heard and perused the record.

2. This first bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (439 of Cr.P.C) for grant of bail relating to Crime No.131/2024 registered at Police Station-Jharda, District-Ujjain (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 342, 506(II), 37, 6 (3),376(2)(n), 457 of IPC, 1860 and under Section 5(l)/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act 2012 and 3(1)(W-ii), 3(2)(va) of SC/ST Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 29.5.2024.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
Investigation is over and chargesheet has been filed.
The statement of prosecutrix and her mother have been recorded before the Court wherein they have not supported the case of prosecution.
The applicant is in jail since 29.5.2024.
Final conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:29101 2 MCRC-42861-2024 4.
On the other hand, learned Govt. Advocate for the State has opposed the prayer.

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case as well as custody period, I am of the view that it is a case, in which applicant may be released on bail.
Consequently without commenting on the merits of the case, bail application filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant/accused be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of IPC.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
